title: Rav Zutra bar Tuvia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 151a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.151a.5-6) relates that his mother, who wished to marry Rav Zevid, wrote her property over to her son; [Rav Zevid] married her and divorced her. She came before Rav Bivi bar Abaye, who said, “[She did it] because of the marriage — and she has married.” Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said to him: “Because you come from Mulai,” etc. Hyman concludes that this Rav Zutra bar Tuvia cannot be Rav’s student.[^1]

notes.text: [Rashbam](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashbam_on_Bava_Batra.151a.6.1-2) reads Mulai as the family’s place and separately glosses the wordplay about defective statements. [Heilprin includes this episode under the Rav Zutra who transmitted Rav’s teachings](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1089&lang=en). Hyman argues that the man in the episode could not have been Rav’s student.
